import sys
sys.path.insert(0,'.')
from h2 import *
GW2 = dict(GW); GW2['zed'] = {'local_domains': ['z.test'], 'peers': {}}
CTX2 = (DIR, ACC, GW2)
T=[]
def add(name, rq, want, gateway='edge', kind='local', subject='s1'):
    T.append((name, [job(rq, gateway=gateway, kind=kind, subject=subject)], want, None))
add('zed primary from', req(), acc('sip:c@z.test'), gateway='zed', subject='s2')
add('zed alias from', req({'From':'<sip:c2@z.test>;tag=t1'}), acc('sip:c@z.test'), gateway='zed', subject='s2')
add('zed disallowed from', req({'From':'<sip:a@x.test>;tag=t1'}), rj('identity'), gateway='zed', subject='s2')
add('zed foreign from', req({'From':'<sip:b@y.test>;tag=t1'}), rj('identity'), gateway='zed', subject='s2')
add('s2 at edge', req({'From':'<sip:c@z.test>;tag=t1'}), rj('identity'), gateway='edge', subject='s2')
add('s1 c from at any', req({'From':'<sip:c@z.test>;tag=t1'}), rj('identity'), gateway='any', subject='s1')
add('s1 ppi c at any', req({'P-Preferred-Identity':'<sip:c@z.test>'}), rj('identity'), gateway='any', subject='s1')
add('s2 anonymous at zed', req({'From':'<sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid>'}), acc('sip:c@z.test', private=True), gateway='zed', subject='s2')
add('s2 anonymous at any', req({'From':'<sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid>'}), rj('identity'), gateway='any', subject='s2')
add('peer c at any', req({'P-Asserted-Identity':'<sip:c@z.test>','From':'<sip:c@z.test>'}), acc('sip:c@z.test', basis='peer'), gateway='any', kind='peer')
add('peer c at far', req({'P-Asserted-Identity':'<sip:c@z.test>','From':'<sip:c@z.test>'}), rj('identity'), gateway='far', kind='peer')
# directory alias cross-scheme: tel alias of c? none. Add via custom dir
DIR3 = dict(DIR); DIR3['sip:c@z.test'] = ['sip:c2@z.test','tel:+15550003']
CTX3 = (DIR3, ACC, GW2)
add('zed tel alias from', req({'From':'<tel:+15550003>;tag=t1'}), acc('sip:c@z.test'), gateway='zed', subject='s2')
for name, jobs, want, wire in T:
    got = run(batch(jobs, CTX2))['results'][0]
    check(name, got, want, wire)
got = run(batch([job(req({'From':'<tel:+15550003>;tag=t1'}), gateway='zed', subject='s2')], CTX3))['results'][0]
check('tel alias dir3', got, acc('sip:c@z.test'))
